dedupe_keys.name: xai4heat scada dataset 2024 hourly district heating substation data from nis serbia 2019 2024

description: The XAI4HEAT SCADA Dataset 2024 gives hourly operating data from five heating substations in residential buildings of a district heating system in Niš, Serbia, extracted from the SCADA system run at the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering of the University of Niš and described in Data in Brief by Cvetković, Zdravković and Ignjatović. It covers five heating seasons from 2019 to 2024, with only the season months from 1 November to 1 April, and three of the substations (L8, L12 and L22) start in 2021. Variables are supply and return temperatures of the heating fluid on the primary and secondary sides, energy transmission measurements and outdoor temperature from a local weather station, after pre-processing and cleaning. Data come as five CSV files, one per substation, with up to about 18,000 hourly samples each. Coverage is one city system. The files are free on Mendeley Data under CC BY 4.0 (the article itself is CC BY-NC). Caveats: five substations is a small sample, summer operation is excluded, and it is processed, not raw SCADA output. Simulation uses are heat demand forecasting, demand response and load shifting control, and explainable models for district heating digital twins. Related records: data-predist-district-heating-substation-faults covers fault data from district heating substations.
